products.short_description: Automate the SOC — Sentinel automation rules and Logic App playbooks that triage, enrich, and respond without human toil.
products.description:
Automate the SOC — Sentinel automation rules and Logic App playbooks that triage, enrich, and respond without human toil.

Analysts burn out doing the same manual triage on every alert. This solution builds Sentinel automation rules and Logic App playbooks that auto-enrich incidents, notify the right people, and take contained response actions — with safe approval gates before anything disruptive.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Automation rules — auto-assign, tag, and trigger by analytics rule/severity
  • Playbooks (Logic Apps) — enrichment, Teams/email notify, ticketing
  • Response actions — disable user, isolate device, block IP (approval-gated)
  • Managed identity & connection security for playbooks
  • Pilot-first rollout with a safe/simulate mode before enforced actions

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A SOC that responds at machine speed for the routine work — with humans in the loop for the consequential calls.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SENTSOAR-Discovery.ps1 — SOAR readiness for Microsoft Sentinel automation rules and playbooks
    • SENTSOAR-Report.ps1 — playbook and automation-rule run-history report
    • SENTSOAR-Set-PlaybookIdentity.ps1 — managed-identity and least-privilege role helper for playbooks
    • SENTSOAR-SimulateResponse.ps1 — simulate-only dry run of the containment response logic
    • SENTSOAR-Validate.ps1 — validate the automation rule and playbooks are configured correctly

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
